subject: Architecture deep-dive & PoC kickoff — scheduling + agenda
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Park <jessica.park@brightscale.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Architecture deep-dive & PoC kickoff — scheduling + agenda

Hi Jessica —

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a technical deep-dive to walk through the PoC architecture as you transition off your current inference provider. High-level goal: validate integration points (KV cache, model variants, rollout/fallback) and agree PoC success criteria + timelines.

Proposed 90-minute slots next week (PST):
- Tue 16 Feb 10:00–11:30
- Wed 17 Feb 13:00–14:30
- Thu 18 Feb 09:00–10:30

Suggested attendees: your lead eng + infra/security; from our side: Dylan (serving runtime), Rishi (security & infra), Grace (solutions).

Draft agenda attached (redwood-poc-agenda-v1.md) and a short PoC checklist (redwood-poc-checklist.pdf). Could you confirm which slot works and who from BrightScale will attend? Also please share any constraints (e.g., disallowed ports, IP whitelisting windows, preferred auth/KMS).

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive & PoC kickoff — scheduling + agenda

Marissa —

Appreciate the agenda and checklist. Good plan. Quick note on availability: Tue 16th is a hard no for our infra lead (on-call rotation), and Thurs 18th conflicts with our quarterly release prep. Wed 17th 13:00 PST should work for Jessica / Ethan; we also want to include our platform security lead (Samir Patel) — I’ll loop him in if that’s okay.

A few items we’d like to add to the agenda from BrightScale side:
- Existing model routing & canary logic (we host variants in-house today)
- KV cache persistence semantics and snapshotting (we’re concerned about cold-starts)
- Expected request volume profile for PoC (burst patterns)

I’ve attached a short doc outlining tenant constraints and our current infra topology (brightscale-tenant-constraints.docx). Can Rishi share any typical network/KMS expectations up front so we can flag blockers?

Best,
Jessica Park
Head of Platform Engineering, BrightScale
jessica.park@brightscale.ai

Attachments: brightscale-tenant-constraints.docx
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive & PoC kickoff — scheduling + agenda

Thanks Jessica — Wed 17th 13:00 PST works on our side.

Proposed refined 90-minute agenda (for alignment):
1) 0–10m: Introductions & success criteria (Marissa)
2) 10–35m: BrightScale current routing & topology (BrightScale)
3) 35–60m: Redwood runtime architecture (Dylan) — batching, KV cache, quantization options
4) 60–75m: Security & networking Q&A (Rishi + Samir)
5) 75–90m: PoC milestones, test plan, next steps (Marissa/Grace)

A couple of asks before the call:
- Jessica: can you drop a small sample of your traffic profile (tokens/sec, p95 request size) — even rough numbers help.
- Samir (or your security contact): please flag any non-starters (e.g., mandatory in-region HSM, disallowed outbound connections) — if there are strict KMS/HSM requirements we’ll triage early.

I’ll prepare a short runtime diagram (diagram_v1.pdf) and link to our SOC2 + network guidance during the call. If Rishi can confirm he’ll cover the security portion that would be great.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

I’ll join Wed 17th 13:00 PST. A few notes to speed the security conversation so we don’t block the PoC kickoff: 
- For private deployments we typically require IP allowlisting for control plane traffic; for hosted PoC we can work with short-lived mTLS tokens.
- If BrightScale requires an in-region HSM/KMS binding, share the vendor and key policies early — otherwise we’ll default to customer-managed keys via our KMS integration (AWS KMS / GCP KMS).
- Please share a redacted copy of your SOC2/attestation or pen-test summary ahead of the call. If you can’t attach to email, a Drive link is fine.

I’m attaching links to our security overview and a short checklist we’ll use during the call.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
